AboutPage.title: We build software with clarity and purpose.
AboutPage.intro: AMY Team Studio is a software development team focused on creating thoughtful digital products and dependable software solutions.
AboutPage.supportingText: Our approach combines practical engineering, clear communication, and attention to the details that shape a product's long-term value.
AboutPage.philosophyTitle: Good software is more than code that works.
AboutPage.philosophyParagraph1: It should solve a real problem, make sense to the people using it, and remain understandable to the people maintaining it.
AboutPage.philosophyParagraph2: That is why we value clear requirements, deliberate technical decisions, and a process that keeps the product's goals at the center.
AboutPage.philosophyQuote: Build for the problem today, with room for what comes next.
AboutPage.principlesIntro: We use these principles to keep our work useful, maintainable, and aligned with the outcomes that matter.
